title: Jacob Appelbaum (Part 2/2) Digital Anti-Repression Workshop - April 26 2012
summary: Part 2 of a Q&A workshop with security researcher Jacob Appelbaum from April 2012, covering mobile phone security, cellphone forensics, state repression and surveillance. Topics include booting Tails from USB and surveillance self-defense resources.
why: Recommended as a practical talk on privacy and anonymity options, including diskless laptops running Tails.

quote.text: Worth listening to Jake Appelbaum's 'digital anti repression workshop' [1].
